rows.grounds: siddhimuktyanusārāt (abl. sg. of compound siddhi-mukti-anusāra, 'according to success and liberation') + vā ('or')
yugapad ('simultaneously') + dvayoḥ (gen. du. of dvi, 'of the two')
naphahrīm (mantra/syllable name 'napha-hrīm') + etau (nom. du. m. of etad, 'these two')
piṇḍau (nom. du. of piṇḍa, 'the two bodies')
saṃghāvihānayoḥ (gen. du. of dvandva compound saṃgha-vihāna, 'of conjunction and separation')
